props.sourceBody:
/*
	    Bit layout is as follows:
	        D7 = n/c
	        D6 = cocktail flip
	        D5 = n/c
	        D4 = n/c
	        D3 = n/c
	        D2 = n/c
	        D1 = n/c
	        D0 = coin meter 1
	*/

	machine().bookkeeping().coin_counter_w(0, (data >> 0) & 1);
	m_mcr_cocktail_flip = (data >> 6) & 1;
m_palette->set_pen_color(index, pal3bit(data >> 6), pal3bit(data >> 0), pal3bit(data >> 3));

m_videoram[offset] = data;
	m_bg_tilemap->mark_tile_dirty(offset / 2);

m_videoram[offset] = data;
	m_bg_tilemap->mark_tile_dirty(offset);

m_spyhunt_alpharam[offset] = data;
	m_alpha_tilemap->mark_tile_dirty(offset);
return m_data[offset];
m_status = data;
return m_status;
machine().scheduler().synchronize(timer_expired_delegate(FUNC(midway_ssio_device::synced_write), this), (offset << 8) | (data & 0xff));
m_data[param >> 8] = param & 0xff;

/* reset cocktail flip */
	m_mcr_cocktail_flip = 0;

// initialize the background tilemap
	m_bg_tilemap = &machine().tilemap().create(*m_gfxdecode, tilemap_get_info_delegate(*this, FUNC(mcr3_state::mcrmono_get_bg_tile_info)), TILEMAP_SCAN_ROWS, 16,16, 32,30);

/* logical (col,row) -> memory offset */
	return (row & 0x0f) | ((col & 0x3f) << 4) | ((row & 0x10) << 6);
tileinfo.set(2, m_spyhunt_alpharam[tile_index], 0, 0);

/* multiplexed steering wheel/gas pedal */
	return m_analog_inputs[m_input_mux]->read();

m_dacval = (data << 2) | (m_dacval & 3);
	m_dac->write(m_dacval);

int combined_state = m_pia->irq_a_state() | m_pia->irq_b_state();
	m_cpu->set_input_line(4, combined_state ? ASSERT_LINE : CLEAR_LINE);
